findings.desc: codex host-2: resolveLearningRoot (learning-store.ts:~85) uses dirname(resolve(searchOrigin, git rev-parse --git-common-dir)), which assumes the git common dir lives inside the main checkout (<main>/.git). True for normal checkout + linked worktrees (Orchestrate normal usage), but FALSE for .git-file layouts: git init --separate-git-dir and bare-backed worktrees point --git-common-dir at external git storage, so the resolver returns <storage-parent>/.lattice/learning instead of the checkout root — a correctness regression for those valid git layouts (changes plain-checkout behavior). Fix: resolve the MAIN worktree root via git worktree list --porcelain (first worktree entry), fallback to searchOrigin; that reports actual checkout paths in all layouts.
